must_block.instructions: Does the visible state indicate an urgent need to stop the opposing team from emptying a hand on its next opportunity? Treat hidden-card estimates as uncertain.

yield_control.instructions: Should this player pass to preserve a farmer teammate's active lead? Answer no for the landlord or if no teammate owns the active play. Account for an enemy intervening.

feed_teammate.instructions: When leading freely, is playing a small single to let the next farmer teammate finish a useful plan? Answer no if not applicable. Use the actual turn order.

pair_pressure.instructions: Can leading a pair keep a one-card enemy from responding while preserving this player's route to finish? Answer no if not applicable.

current_action_instructions: Which legal action best serves this player's team winning objective? Use turn order, visible information, computed action features and uncertain tactical assessments. Either farmer finishing is equally a farmer victory. Do not treat a seat heuristic as mandatory.
hybrid_instructions: Choose the legal action that best serves this player's team reward. Compare the supplied immediate consequences and rollout estimates. The estimates depend on uniform hidden-card assignments and simple continuation policies, are not optimal values or real win probabilities. Either farmer finishing is equally a farmer victory. You may disagree with the simulation ranking.
limitations: Only the initial decision differs; all subsequent players use shared evaluation policies.
Planning uses cooperative/greedy continuation; evaluation uses random/pressure instead.
Hidden assignments are enumerated with uniform card-instance weights, not a calibrated behavioral posterior.
Evaluation reward is specific to these synthetic snapshots and policies, not full-game AI strength.
Human references and full-information solver are diagnostics only, never pass/fail gates.
Reported usage covers successful decisions; a partially failed decision may have unreported billed tokens.

rules.reward: Landlord wins: landlord +1, each farmer -1; either farmer finishes: both farmers +1, landlord -1. No tactical bonus.

rules.scope: Each remaining hand has at most 4 cards; the remaining pool has at most 2 cards per ordinary rank. Only singles, pairs and rocket can occur. No bidding, multipliers or spring bonuses.
